purpose: Define outcome-independent semantic criteria for turning raw external interaction records into larval host candidates.
admissible_interaction_semantics: The record must explicitly encode trophic use, feeding, or a host relationship consistent with the Lepidoptera taxon using the plant taxon.
The non-Lepidoptera partner must resolve to a land-plant taxon.
Provider orientation may be reversed only when the interaction verb makes consumer-host direction unambiguous.
excluded_semantics: visits or pollinates without larval host evidence
the Lepidoptera taxon acting as prey or host of a predator, parasitoid, pathogen, or symbiont
records lacking a resolvable plant partner
records whose interaction meaning cannot be oriented unambiguously

cross_check.frozen_reference: LepTraits single larval host family from the primary 192-species panel
cross_check.rule: A species-level plant host may enter the historical-host set only if its resolved plant family matches the frozen LepTraits host family. Mismatches remain in the audit ledger but do not enter the primary host set.
cross_check.accepted_host_species_weighting: equal host-species weight; publication or observation count may not weight a host more heavily
